After purchasing the vehicle, you will receive an email to complete the registration of your account on the web portal and activate the connected services available for the purchased vehicle. Once you have completed your account registration and service activation, the system will activate all the services and send you a confirmation email. Now you can enjoy Uconnect™ Services!
 
The compatibility of the available services and features may vary depending on the vehicle model, the infotainment system installed in the vehicle and the country in which the vehicle is sold. More information is available on the website dedicated to your vehicle and in the customer area.

For all new Fiat and Abarth vehicles ordered on or after 23rd January 2023, new Fiat Professional vehicles ordered on or after 6th November 2023 equipped with a telematics box: My Assistant is included in the price of the vehicle in the Connect ONE pack. My Remote, My Car, My Navigation and My eCharge services are included in the Connect PLUS pack which requires customer's subscription. Connect PLUS is available at no additional cost for a 6 month trial period starting from the warranty start date. My Alert and My Wi-Fi services remain optional and require additional subscription. 

*Applies to new ordered cars only. The launch date and trial duration depends on country, check the FIAT website to find out more.
